text:
Priya Rao: Hey folks — quick cloud access ask as I'm getting my first-week experiments wired up. Need access for project `redwood-dev-priya`
- GCP KMS: CryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on key `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/dev/cryptoKeys/redwood-dev-kms`
- GCP storage: roles/storage.objectViewer on bucket `redwood-embeddings-dev`
- Region permissions for europe-west4 and asia-south1 (want to run small batch evals there)
- TPU quota bump: +2 v2 chips (for short experiments)
- AWS cross-account role access to arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/Redwood-Dev-Access to pull infra logs
Any pointers on process or who to loop in? Thanks!

Liam Chen: welcome Priya! quick q — project-level or org-level access for the KMS key? we try to avoid org-wide keys unless necessary.

Priya Rao: project-level is fine. project id is `redwood-dev-priya`. The key lives under the prod keyring (see path above) because we reuse a dev CMK. Data classification: non-sensitive dev prompts / debug logs.

Sai Patel: @Liam tagging infra. If the key is in prod keyring we need security approval. Priya — can you confirm manager ok to grant KMS usage? Also please add why you need the AWS role when you file the ticket.

Priya Rao: Manager is Jamie Lee — happy to have them approve here. AWS role reason: need VPC flow logs + CloudWatch metrics from that account for infra debugging.

Jamie Lee: Approved. Fine to proceed with project-level KMS for Priya's dev work.

Sai Patel: OK — I'll open an ops ticket and handle the GCP IAM changes once sec signs off. Plan: 1) submit security approval for prod key use 2) grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on that cryptoKey to service account `sa-priya@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com` 3) give `roles/storage.objectViewer` on the bucket 4) add compute.regionViewer for europe-west4 + asia-south1 for the relevant service account. TPU quota I'll request via GCP quota page (estimate: 2 v2 chips).

Priya Rao: thanks — what's ETA?

Sai Patel: IAM changes usually same-day once sec ack. Quota requests 24–48h depending on Google. AWS cross-account role request goes to infra-aws team — might take a day. I'll include a time-limited bind option if you need it faster.

Priya Rao: time-limited is fine (7 days would work).

ops-bot: Ticket OPS-4827 created by Sai Patel. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4827

Sai Patel: Filed OPS-4827 and added security reviewers. Also filed cross-account AWS request referencing external account `987654321098`. Priya, can you add a short justification in the ticket for audit (one sentence is fine)?

Priya Rao: added justification: "Experiment infra troubleshooting: need logs + metrics to correlate embeddings infra behavior across regions."

Sai Patel: IAM applied for KMS + storage at 1902467945 — please verify you can use the key/storage. Quota request submitted. AWS request opened to infra-aws.

Priya Rao: Confirmed — I can encrypt/decrypt and list objects in the bucket. Tried a small encrypt locally and it worked. :tada:

Sai Patel: Great. Keeping this open until TPU quota approved and AWS role granted. @sec-bot / Security please ack product-key usage for non-sensitive dev workloads.

sec-bot: Security acknowledged for non-sensitive dev data. Please ensure service account keys are short-lived and rotate credentials per policy.

Sai Patel: Noted. Closing actions: follow up on quota + AWS role and update OPS-4827. Priya, ping here if anything breaks during tests.
